name: @ffwd/api-client-kapable
description: Kapable-platform adapter for the ffwd API client: a durable write-through Store for the platform's data service and Sign in with Kapable SSO auth. Depends on @ffwd/api-client-server.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --external @ffwd/api-client-server && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
